title: James Bond 007 in Agent Under Fire (Sony PlayStation 2) Complete Tested Working
descriptionText:
Experience the thrill of being James Bond with this complete and tested working game for the Sony PlayStation 2. Immerse yourself in the action-packed shooter game, "James Bond 007 in Agent Under Fire" by EA Games. This game is perfect for fans of the genre and those who love a good challenge. 

With a rating of T-Teen, this game is suitable for all players aged 13 and above. The game is coded for NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) and will work perfectly on your Sony PlayStation 2. Don't miss out on this opportunity to add a classic game to your collection.
